newsitem.title: GREECE: Alpha Credit Bank says no deal with Ergo bank.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Credit Bank says no deal with Ergo bank.

text.p: Private Alpha Credit Bank reiterated there has been no exchange of block shares between Alpha Credit Bank and private ErgoBank and no accords between shareholders or the two banks' top brass.
It said in a statement that Alpha Credit Bank favours the restructuring of the banking system and the merger of banks that will lead to the creation of competitive banks at a European level.
"In this context, the bank is following developments and looking into every possible case," it added.
The Greek government has said it intends to privatise a few small state banks and the Bank of Crete.

There have been reports in recent weeks in the Greek press that Alpha Credit was interested in buying a major stake in ErgoBank. They said Alpha had contacted foreign institutional investors and local investors with large holdings in ErgoBank.
